sources.title: Injuries keep Rico Dowdle, Jamel Dean out of Steelers practice
sources.description: The Steelers’ Week 3 injury report for Wednesday included four players who did not participate. According to Steelers.com, running back Rico Dowdle (toe), cornerback Jamel Dean (ankle), cornerback Jalen Ramsey (rest day) and linebacker Cole Holcomb (personal) all did not practice.
